_doc: The garage's wheel types (scripts/vehicle/wheel_presets.gd reads this; docs/wheels.md). Each preset is a whole wheel assembly: its rim, its tyre, its brakes, fitted to the car's own wheel size at every corner (front and rear apart: the physics tyre radius never changes with the look). build: 'gen' (scripts/vehicle/wheel_gen.gd, any size) or 'mesh' (a converted CC0 wheel, assets/wheels/). aspect: the tyre's sidewall over its width; width_k and offset (m, outwards) against the stock wheel. kind: stock, street, vintage, wide, track, formula; classes: the cars it's offered on (road: everything you can drive on the road; track: the GT and prototype cars; formula: single-seaters). Fictional names only: no real wheel brand, no logos. price: credits, bought once (then on any car it fits). The fit itself (does it clear the arches at full lock and full bump?) is data/wheel_fit.json, measured by tools/wheel_fit.gd.

far._doc: Far away (past far_m) every wheel is a low-poly stand-in, one of the CC0 wheels converted by tools/import_wheels.py (the IceMaan CC96 rims, the USD Mini Car Kit's wheels): a preset's own 'far', else its kind's here. Its rim takes the wheel colour too.
